legal_units.title: Tax audit.
legal_units.text: Conditions For Getting Books Of Account Audited: Every person— (a) carrying on business shall, if his total sales, turnover or gross receipts, as the case may be, in business exceed or exceeds one crore rupees in any tax year, subject to the provisions of clause (b); (b) in case of a person whose— clause (a) shall have effect as if for the words "one crore rupees", the words "ten crore rupees" had been substituted; (i) aggregate of all amounts received including amount received for sales, turnover or gross receipts during the tax year, in cash, does not exceed 5% of the said amount; and (ii) aggregate of all payments made including amount incurred for expenditure, in cash, during the tax year does not exceed 5% of the said payment, (c) carrying on profession shall, if his gross receipts in profession exceed fifty lakh rupees in any tax year.
